title: Demon X Angel Can't Get Along!
titleRomaji: Emo x Tianshi Buneng Youhao Xiangchu
titleEnglish: Demon X Angel Can't Get Along!
titleNative: 恶魔X天使 不能友好相处
synopsis: Demons and angels are natural enemies that have grown tired of fighting each other. In order to coexist peacefully, they decided to arrange a marriage between the two races! If the pair can't get along within the one-year trial period, the marriage will be dissolved. This is how Jiacheng (Demon) and Yu Shanshan (Angel) became the chosen "lucky" pair for the marriage. Sharing the goal of divorce, the two began their lives of "happy" cohabitation! (Source: Bilibili Comics)

title: Maou-sama no Kinyoubi
synonyms: The Demon Lord's Day Off: Friday
synopsis: The Demon Lord, who was once defeated in battle by a hero, was suddenly transported from the demon world to modern-day Japan due to a runaway spell she cast at the end of the battle. Having efficiently recovered most of the magical power she had lost in the previous battle by consuming modern food, the Demon Lord returns to the Demon World once again. Despite reigning over the demon world as the Demon Lord, she frequently makes secret visits to Japan, spending her days eating easily obtainable convenience store food. One day, by chance, she came across a back alley in a busy downtown area and ended up helping a girl who was being harassed by several men. As a reward for helping her, she was taken to a cozy oden restaurant... The serious and rigid "Demon Lord" discovers truly delicious food and drinks, and friends to share them with after work. (Source: Tonari no Young Jump, translated)

title: Himuro no Tenchi: Fate/school Life
synopsis: Fate/school life is a comedy 4-koma manga revolving around the normal life at school of the minor characters of Fate/stay night and Fate/Hollow Ataraxia, specifically the character Himuro Kane, classmate of Fate/stay night protagonist Emiya Shirou. This manga by Mashin Eiichirou is a spin-off that tells the normal school life of the supporting characters Himuro Kane, Makidera Kaede, Saegusa Yukika. Other characters are the regular cast of the main games: Mitsuzuri Ayako, Tohsaka Rin, Ryuudou Issei, Matou Shinji, Emiya Shirou, Kuzuki Souichirou, Fujimura Taiga, Matou Sakura, Mitsuzuri Minori; "guest" characters from other series Ciel, Seven, Sajyou Ayaka (formerly the heroine of the never finished prototype novel of Fate/stay night) are also featured, and other classmates Gotou Gai, Fujimoto, Dezaki, Hirumata. The story is centered around classic school events such as a ball game tournament, field trips and inter high school competitions. As such, there is no reference at all to supernatural things like magecraft and Heroic Spirits. br> Note: Includes 18 extra chapters.

titleRomaji: Nito no Taidana Isekai Shoukougun: Saijaku Shoku "Healer" nano ni Saikyou wa Cheat desu ka?
titleNative: ニトの怠惰な異世界症候群 ~最弱職〈ヒーラー〉なのに最強はチートですか?~
synonyms: Nito no Taidana Isekai Shoukougun Sai Jakushoku "Healer" Nano ni Saikyou wa Desu ka?
synopsis: Hidako Masamune is a high school student who suffers from continuous bullying by his classmates. Becoming tired of it all, he decides to commit suicide, but instead he is transported to another world along with all his classmates. When they arrive, they find that they now possess amazing abilities but he was only granted the status of a "healer," the weakest skill of all. The king decides to get rid of him by transporting him to another far away place, but not before Hidako swears revenge against the king, the kingdom, and all of his classmates.

titleNative: 最強女師匠たちが育成方針を巡って修羅場
synonyms: The Strongest Female Masters Are Warring Over Training Policy
synopsis: “These three could destroy the country all by themselves if they wanted… But there was one thing they just couldn't get.” For the three strongest adventurers in the world, finding a man strong enough to be with them is a herculean task. He simply doesn’t exist. With that in mind, they decide to take on a perfect novice—the level-zero, unremarkable Cross Alacart—and train him up to be their perfect match. Freshly expelled from Adventurers’ school, Cross sets his eyes on redemption; training hard and learning to believe in himself along the way. (Source: Comikey)
